package.name: wojtek_nav
package.description:
Navigation for wojtek, starting with what it stands on: a rolling local costmap in the odom frame, built from the depth camera, with memory of what the fixed 70-degree camera can no longer see.
Launch plus configuration only: it composes third-party nodes (image_proc decimation, depth_image_proc deprojection, nav2_costmap_2d) around this package's settings, the way wojtek_perception_bringup composes the camera driver. The odometry it builds on is wojtek_odometry's; the streams are the camera bringup's.
